h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Tezpur

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Tezpur

items.pText: Tezpur sits on the north bank of the Brahmaputra and is home to a central university, an Air Force station and a large army presence. Much of the demand for playgrounds here comes from inside these campuses, where families live in quarters with their own parks. FunPlay Systems makes outdoor playground equipment for them, and for schools and town parks, at our factory in Vasai East, about 2,190 km away.

The climate is humid, with heavy rain from about May to September and mild winters. We dispatch the equipment by road to Tezpur, and our installation team or a dealer in eastern India sets it up. Share the size of the park, photos and the ages of the children. We send back a layout drawing with the safe play area marked, which you can put up for approval.

props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

richText.heading: Working inside a defence or university campus

c: Installation on a secured campus needs a little paperwork before the truck arrives. Ask your estate or works office early about vehicle entry, the names of our installers and the hours when work is allowed. We can share the list of pieces and the layout drawing in advance, which most offices need for their file.
Choose a park location with firm, raised ground, since rain in this part of Assam can go on for months. Galvanised posts and roto-moulded parts handle the wet season well. A

items.q: Can your team install equipment on a defence campus?
items.a: Yes, once entry permission is arranged. We share the list of pieces, the layout drawing and the installers' details in advance so your office can issue passes before installation day.

items.q: Is the equipment suited to Assam's long rainy season?
items.a: Galvanised steel posts and roto-moulded plastic parts do not rust. Install on firm, raised ground with good drainage, and use rubber flooring so the surface stays usable after rain.

items.q: How far is your factory from Tezpur?
items.a: About 2,190 km. We manufacture in Vasai East, Maharashtra, send the equipment by road and install it through our own team or a dealer in eastern India.
